instruction_following.question: How do I use Green's functions to solve a PDE?
instruction_following.llm_response: For L u = f on a domain Ω, choose G satisfying L G(x,ξ)=δ(x−ξ) with the required homogeneous boundary condition. For the 1-D example −u''=f on [0,1], u(0)=u(1)=0, G(x,ξ)=min(x,ξ)[1−max(x,ξ)], so u(x)=∫₀¹G(x,ξ)f(ξ)dξ. If f(ξ)=1, evaluating the two integrals gives u(x)=x(1−x)/2.
